::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `BinarizeImage` {-}

Converts an image to pure black-and-white, using Otsu's method to automatically select the threshold between the two, and saves the result to another image file.
Returns true if image was successfully saved.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean BinarizeImage(string inputImagePath,
                      string outputImagePath,
                      number thresholdAdjustment)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputImagePath |  |
| `string` outputImagePath |  |
| `number` thresholdAdjustment | (Optional) An offset added to the threshold that Otsu's method selects, clamped to a valid luminance value (`0`-`255`). Raising this preserves lighter grays as black; lowering it turns more of them white. Default is `0`. |


:::
